headline: Barangay Social Services Aide

education.credential: Senior High School, Humanities and Social Sciences (HUMSS) strand
notes: Work immersion with a community welfare organisation

summary: Senior high school graduate from the HUMSS strand looking for work as a social services aide. During work immersion I helped a community welfare council register families for assistance, talk with them about their needs and keep their forms complete. I am patient, respectful and good with elderly residents.
skills: Talking with families and elderly residents in Waray and Filipino
Keeping client forms and case files complete

experience.title: Work Immersion Student
bullets: Helped staff register 180 families for typhoon relief and checked each form for missing details.
Visited senior citizens at home with a social worker to update their records.
Encoded family profiles into the council's Excel database.
